name: Christian Hubicki

name: Dennis Hong

name: Elena Messina
selection_rationale: Elena Messina contributed to named joint standards and testing outputs for robotics.
evidence_scope: Documented joint standards and test contributions; individual and institutional functions retain separate attribution.

evidence_scope: Project attribution; Randi Klett, Evan Ackerman and the design and development teams retain shared contributions, with readership effects unmeasured.

name: Fei-Fei Li

name: Francesca Rossi

name: Geordie Rose
selection_rationale: Geordie Rose describes building robotics partnerships through investment and licensing; Apptronik's CEO credits his board support.

name: Henrik Christensen

evidence_scope: UCSD attribution and joint roadmap publications, with co-authors and workshop participants sharing the contribution.
